title: Tien GPT phase 2
author: Tien N.
desc:
Compounds: Usually stop at ~1 RIR; Week 4 can reach 0–1 RIR while form remains clean.
Drop-set rule: On FINAL working set only, reduce load 25–35% and continue for the prescribed extra reps.
Rest-pause rule: On FINAL set only, reach technical failure, rest 15–20 sec, then perform 3–5 more clean reps.

ex.note: ABS FIRST. Curl pelvis upward; no swinging.
Start around 195 lb based on P1. Drive elbows toward hips. · Weights: 195 lb
Start around 55 lb. Keep chest planted; pull elbow toward hip. · Weights: 55 lb
Use one consistent working load; full overhead stretch.
Rear-delt focus; do not turn it into a row.
Biceps first direct movement; shoulder stays behind torso.
Controlled; forearm/brachialis emphasis.
ABS FIRST. Progress load while keeping spinal flexion.
Use 255 only if all sets stay ≥6; otherwise slightly reduce. Physique > ego. · Weights: 255 lb
Lower-chest priority. Start around 180 lb from P1 baseline. · Weights: 180 lb
No drop set Week 1. Control stretch and squeeze down/in.
Use 77.5 lb as current baseline if machine is same. · Weights: 77.5 lb
Long-head focus; elbows fixed.
Strict reps; no shrugging.
ABS FIRST.
CORE FIRST. Rotate through torso; control return.
Deep standardized ROM. Start above 320 only if depth is identical.
Keep 750 lb until you own the range cleanly. · Weights: 750 lb
Full lengthened stretch; controlled eccentric.
Keep 190 until 15/15, then add load. · Weights: 190 lb
Increase from 230 if same machine; deep stretch. · Weights: 230 lb
